name: Concordia Cooperative AI Challenge
description: Develop autonomous language model agents capable of cooperative reasoning, communication, and decision-making in text-mediated, multi-agent environments.

cr:input.name: Input Dataset
cr:input.description: The input dataset consists of a single column named 'id' representing unique sample identifiers. Example values include 'sample_000', 'sample_001', etc.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset source URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output consists of predictions in CSV format with two columns: 'id' (matching input IDs) and 'pred' (predicted values as floats). Example values for 'pred' include 0.3456541535501251 and 0.8813422599917877.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for each sample, matching the input dataset. Example values: 'sample_000', 'sample_001'.

field.name: pred
field.description: Predicted value for each sample. Example values: 0.3456541535501251, 0.8813422599917877.

cr:evaluation.notes: The primary metric is computed using Pearson correlation between ground truth and predictions. Secondary metric is mean squared error. Tertiary metric is qualitative analysis, which is a placeholder set to 0.0.
